The '''Scorekeeper's Javelin''' was a legendary weapon that was believed to never miss its intended target. The Javelin was named for the [[Scorekeeper/Legends|Scorekeeper]], the deity of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and it was reportedly sighted on a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Scorekeeper's Javelin}}</ref>
